_purpose: Maps the role and owner keys the ENGINE emits to an addressee Body can actually message. Consulted, never invented: a key with no entry, or an entry with no address, renders as NOT ROUTABLE and names the key. The kit stays offline — it resolves the key to a display name and an address string, and Body does the delivering.
_why_nulls: These addresses ship EMPTY on purpose. Inventing a Teams group id or a mailbox would be fabrication of exactly the kind this kit exists to prevent, and a wrong assignee is worse than a visible gap: the case goes to someone who ignores it and nobody learns it was misrouted. Fill them in for a deployment; until then every route says NOT ROUTABLE and names the key that needs filling.
_keys: Three vocabularies share this table. routing.recommendation (3 values) and open_items[].route (4 values) are schema enums — if the engine gains a value it will be UNKNOWN here, which is the loud direction. checkpoints[].owner is free text the engine writes, so those keys must match its strings exactly.
